passage: The art class visited the city museum on Friday to study ancient sculpture and sketch the works on display. Walking through the museum's quiet galleries, ______
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
choices: the students admired the ancient marble sculptures on display.
the ancient marble sculptures impressed the visiting students.
the marble sculptures on display were admired by the students.
there were many ancient marble sculptures for the students.
steps: "Walking through the museum's quiet galleries" must describe whoever comes right after the comma.
The students were walking, not the sculptures.
Only the choice beginning with "the students" places the walkers next to the modifier.
key: An introductory modifier describes the noun right after the comma.
